tasks.title: Learn how labs and the run options work

quiz.question: What does a chapter's lab give you?
options: A ready-to-run project with the chapter's starting files and pinned dependencies
A recorded video of the solution
A different color theme for this site
quiz.explanation: A lab is a complete project: the starting files plus `uv.lock` and `requirements.txt`, so one setup command gets you the exact versions everyone uses.

quiz.question: If you switch “Run with” from uv to venv, what happens?
options: Command examples adapt to venv, and the choice sticks across pages
The course switches to a different programming language
quiz.explanation: The picker changes how commands are shown on every page: `uv run robot checks` becomes `robot checks` in an activated venv. Set each lab up once for the runner you chose.

deck.note: A chapter's prepared project, downloaded as a .zip: starting files plus pinned dependencies, set up with one command.
The uv / venv / poetry picker on lessons with commands; every command example adapts to it, and the choice sticks across pages.
